goal: Recover actual shared dataset-available capacity above the configured Nix GC target without weakening thresholds
scope: Inspect consumers and active writers, identify exact rebuildable artifacts, obtain required destructive-operation authority, then perform and verify bounded recovery
constraints: No deletion of historical evidence, product data or unrelated working trees
No interference with live Workday builds
No shared-process signals or host GC threshold reduction
No new Nix acceptance retry inferred from capacity inspection

active_build_snapshot.limit: Point-in-time metadata; do not signal these processes or infer inactivity at cleanup time

one_time_exception.reason: Shared host capacity blocks the unchanged-source acceptance prerequisite for current Molten work
one_time_exception.recurrence_decision: Bounded recovery only; do not introduce an unreviewed automatic retention or deletion policy
one_time_exception.revisit_trigger: Dataset-available capacity falls below the configured Nix thresholds again
one_time_exception.owner: Host operator and Molten build maintainers
one_time_exception.non_claim: Reclaimed capacity alone is not passing product acceptance or a permanent retention guarantee
